subject.title: fix(voice-call): ngrok tunnels no longer survive cleanup

question: Should this PR become the single canonical implementation for ngrok startup-timeout and shutdown cleanup, superseding the overlapping lifecycle changes in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109416?
rationale: The two branches modify the same timer, child-closure, and timeout ownership semantics; choosing the enduring design is a maintainer merge decision rather than a safe mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt this bounded lifecycle
options.body: Land this PR as the canonical SIGTERM-to-SIGKILL and close-wait design, then close or rebase the overlapping PR so only one timeout lifecycle remains.

options.title: Prefer the related narrow patch
options.body: Land the timer-focused approach from the related PR first, then ask for this branch to be rebased into a follow-up that preserves the chosen lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt this bounded lifecycle
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the canonical SIGTERM-to-SIGKILL and close-wait design, then close or rebase the overlapping PR so only one timeout lifecycle remains.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent open implementation and are the best available routing contact in the supplied evidence for resolving the overlap.
